items.source: Return the wrapped StompDecoder.
items.translation: 返回包装的StompDecoder。

items.source:
A single instance of this decoder can be invoked repeatedly to read all
messages from a single stream (for example, WebSocket session) as long as decoding
does not fail. If there is an exception, StompDecoder instance should not
be used any more as its internal state is not guaranteed to be consistent.
It is expected that the underlying session is closed at that point.
items.translation: 此解码器的单个实例可被重复调用，以读取来自单个流（例如 WebSocket 会话）的所有消息，前提是解码未失败。如果发生异常，则不应再使用 StompDecoder 实例，因为其内部状态无法保证一致性。此时预期底层会话已关闭。

items.source:
If there was enough data to parse a "content-length" header, then the
value is used to determine how much more data is needed before a new
attempt to decode is made.
items.translation: 如果有足够的数据来解析"content-length"标头，则使用该值来确定在尝试再次解码之前还需要多少数据。

items.source:
If there was not enough data to parse the "content-length", or if there
is "content-length" header, every subsequent call to decode attempts to
parse again with all available data. Therefore the presence of a "content-length"
header helps to optimize the decoding of large messages.
items.translation: 如果数据不足以解析"content-length"，或者存在"content-length"标头，则随后的每次 decode 调用都会尝试使用所有可用数据再次解析。因此，"content-length"标头的存在有助于优化大消息的解码。

items.source: Decodes one or more STOMP frames from the given ByteBuffer into a list of Messages.
items.translation: 将给定ByteBuffer中的一个或多个 STOMP 帧解码为Messages列表。

items.source: Create a new BufferingStompDecoder wrapping the given StompDecoder.
items.translation: 创建一个新的BufferingStompDecoder来包装给定的StompDecoder。

items.source: Return the configured buffer size limit.
items.translation: 返回配置的缓冲区大小限制。

items.source: Get the expected content length of the currently buffered, incomplete STOMP frame.
items.translation: 获取当前缓冲的不完整 STOMP 帧的预期内容长度。

items.source: StompConversionException - raised in case of decoding issues
items.translation: StompConversionException - 在解码出现问题时抛出

items.source: newBuffer - a buffer containing new data to decode
items.translation: newBuffer - 包含要解码的新数据的缓冲区

items.source: decoded messages or an empty list
items.translation: 解码后的消息或空列表
